resources.string: Save encrypted chat history online and restore messages for chats you’re in on this device.
White Noise saves encrypted chat history to online file storage (Blossom servers). Your Nostr relays hold an encrypted record the app uses to find your backups.
You can restore messages only in chats this device is currently in. If you lose access to a group, ask someone who can invite you to add you again.
On. This device saves your backups.
On. Another of your devices saves your backups.
This version of White Noise can’t make or restore history backups yet. They will arrive in a later update.
New backups use the new words. Older backups still need your old words.
Your account stops saving new backups. Backups already saved stay online, and your recovery words can still restore them.
This device saves a backup about once a day while it is charging on Wi-Fi.
Type word %1$d and word %2$d from your list. If you didn’t write them down, cancel and start again for new words.
Join the chats on this device first. Then enter all 12 words, separated by spaces.
Restore finished, but some backups couldn’t be read. Messages restored: %1$d
No backups were found for these words.
Those words don’t match. Check your list and try again.
Your account is busy with another change. Try again in a moment.
Couldn’t read your account’s devices. Try again later.
Those aren’t valid recovery words. Check the spelling and enter all 12 words.
These words are no longer valid. Start again to get new words.
A backup has older messages for this chat. To bring them in, enter the same recovery words again in Settings → Data & storage → History backups.
Make sure no one can see your screen. Reveal and save these words somewhere safe.
